name: one-shot-editing
description: Turn raw talking-head footage into captioned vertical shorts with music, B-roll, and quality checks.

interface.shortDescription: Edit talking-head footage into vertical shorts.
interface.longDescription: Select a hook, cut pauses and retakes, reframe, add captions, music and B-roll, and check the final video. Supports English and Brazilian Portuguese.
defaultPrompt: Edit this video into a vertical short with one-shot-editing.
